question: What happens to action impressions of the limited knower?
premises: We speak the topic of the described limited knower.
With non-ego union all action impressions are dissolved.
Thus the limited knower's impressions dissolve.
inference: With non-ego union, all action impressions of the limited knower are dissolved.
plain_english: We speak the topic of the described limited knower: with non-ego union all action impressions are dissolved.
